key_insight: Better load estimation via Ensemble Score Filtering makes grid-control decisions more reliable under uncertainty, improving both heuristic and PPO-based performance.
engineering_relevance: For transmission-grid operators, coupling data assimilation with reinforcement learning can improve resilience when demand data are noisy, uncertain, or out of distribution.
method: Build a DC-power-flow grid simulator with stochastic loads, renewable-like generation, storage, dispatch, and line protection.
Use an Ensemble Score Filter (EnSF) to denoise load observations before control.
Evaluate both a fixed heuristic and frozen PPO policies under Forward, EnSF-corrected, and Truth information.
evidence_signal: Across paired stochastic scenarios, EnSF consistently reduced load-estimation error and improved survival, return, warning exposure, and overload exposure, especially when load uncertainty was larger than the training regime.
watch_item: Results are shown in a simplified DC-network simulator, so transfer to full AC grid dynamics and real operational constraints may require additional validation.
paper_title: Data-Assimilation-Assisted Reinforcement Learning for Power Grid Control under Load Uncertainty
